description: This file defines the 'Tag' result class for the Coocook schema, including its columns, relationships, and a method to determine if the tag can be deleted.

classes.name: Coocook::Schema::Result::Tag
classes.description: A Moose-based ORM class representing the 'tags' table, with relationships to projects, tag groups, articles, dishes, and recipes.

methods.name: deletable
methods.description: Checks whether the tag can be safely deleted by verifying that it has no associated articles, dishes, or recipes.
